name: Processing Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of processing restrictions the central system must apply.

RJCT.name: Rejection
RJCT.definition: Restriction is the rejection during the settlement instruction validation.

CVHD.name: CSD Validation Hold
CVHD.definition: Restriction is setting the CSD validation automatically to hold when accepting a settlement instruction.

RSVT.name: Reservation
RSVT.definition: Restriction is the creation of a reservation of a cash balance or a securities position for a specific purpose.

BLCK.name: Blocking
BLCK.definition: Restriction is the blocking of a party, securities account, security or cash account from settlement, blocking of securities position or cash balance for a specific purpose.

EARM.name: Earmarking
EARM.definition: Restriction of linked to the balance type that defines and manages position types for securities positions.

EFAC.name: Earmarking For Auto Collateralisation
EFAC.definition: Restriction of linked to the balance type that defines and manages position types for securities positions for auto-collateralisation.

COLD.name: Collateralised
COLD.definition: Restriction is linked to a sub-pledged collateral transaction.

CSDB.name: Co SD Blocking
CSDB.definition: Restriction does not support any partial execution.
